profile.name: Sindoh DP103 PLA translated from the official 3DWOX profile

human_units.bed_adhesion: one DP103 skirt line; excluded from support-only metric

build_plate.mesh_placement: AABB centred at (width/2, depth/2), minimum z=0

mesh_scaling.rule: uniform scale to target axis-aligned bounding-box diagonal

metrics.cura_parser_method: TYPE:SUPPORT segments with E high-water-mark correction
metrics.tomo: cached TOMO_CPU v_ss at 1-degree resolution and 60-degree critical angle
metrics.tomo_unit: native v_ss proxy units (rank comparisons only)

candidate_rule.ranking_panel: same 16-point directed spherical-Fibonacci panel for every mesh; independent of TOMO scores
candidate_rule.deduplication: exact canonical 1-degree yaw/pitch grid cell; 360-degree endpoints removed
candidate_rule.regret_scope: TOMO global optimum versus best Cura support among all sliced panel+anchor directions
candidate_rule.top_k_definition: set overlap fraction |TOMO top-k intersect Cura top-k| / k
candidate_rule.tie_break: candidate_id lexical order after metric value
